build_supernet_network: build a PyTorch super-network for NAS with configurable cells, channels, and classification layers
create_mixedop_module: create a MixedOp module that computes a weighted sum of candidate operations on input tensors
create_cell_module: create a Cell module with preprocess layers and MixedOp operations for normal or reduction steps
change_network_masks: change the supernet normal and reduce masks on a Network instance to update architecture weights
run_network_forward: run a forward pass through the Network super-network to get classification logits from input images
